  33  def power_chisq_bins_from_sigmasq_series(sigmasq_series, num_bins, kmin, kmax):
  34      """Returns bins of equal power for use with the chisq functions
  35  
  36      Parameters
  37      ----------
  38  
  39      sigmasq_series: FrequencySeries
  40          A frequency series containing the cumulative power of a filter template
  41          preweighted by a psd.
  42      num_bins: int
  43          The number of chisq bins to calculate.
  44      kmin: int
  45          DOCUMENTME
  46      kmax: int
  47          DOCUMENTME
  48  
  49      Returns
  50      -------
  51  
  52      bins: List of ints
  53          A list of the edges of the chisq bins is returned.
  54      """
  55      sigmasq = sigmasq_series[kmax - 1]
  56      edge_vec = numpy.arange(0, num_bins) * sigmasq / num_bins
  57      bins = numpy.searchsorted(sigmasq_series[kmin:kmax], edge_vec, side='right')
  58      bins += kmin
  59      return numpy.append(bins, kmax)

  62  def power_chisq_bins(htilde, num_bins, psd, low_frequency_cutoff=None,
  63                       high_frequency_cutoff=None):
  64      """Returns bins of equal power for use with the chisq functions
  65  
  66      Parameters
  67      ----------
  68  
  69      htilde: FrequencySeries
  70          A frequency series containing the template waveform
  71      num_bins: int
  72          The number of chisq bins to calculate.
  73      psd: FrequencySeries
  74          A frequency series containing the psd. Its length must be commensurate
  75          with the template waveform.
  76      low_frequency_cutoff: {None, float}, optional
  77          The low frequency cutoff to apply
  78      high_frequency_cutoff: {None, float}, optional
  79          The high frequency cutoff to apply
  80  
  81      Returns
  82      -------
  83  
  84      bins: List of ints
  85          A list of the edges of the chisq bins is returned.
  86      """
  87      sigma_vec = sigmasq_series(htilde, psd, low_frequency_cutoff,
  88                                 high_frequency_cutoff).numpy()
  89      kmin, kmax = get_cutoff_indices(low_frequency_cutoff,
  90                                      high_frequency_cutoff,
  91                                      htilde.delta_f,
  92                                      (len(htilde)-1)*2)
  93      return power_chisq_bins_from_sigmasq_series(sigma_vec, num_bins, kmin, kmax)

 111  def power_chisq_at_points_from_precomputed(corr, snr, snr_norm, bins, indices):
 112      """Calculate the chisq timeseries from precomputed values for only select points.
 113  
 114      This function calculates the chisq at each point by explicitly time shifting
 115      and summing each bin. No FFT is involved.
 116  
 117      Parameters
 118      ----------
 119      corr: FrequencySeries
 120          The product of the template and data in the frequency domain.
 121      snr: numpy.ndarray
 122          The unnormalized array of snr values at only the selected points in `indices`.
 123      snr_norm: float
 124          The normalization of the snr (EXPLAINME : refer to Findchirp paper?)
 125      bins: List of integers
 126          The edges of the equal power bins
 127      indices: Array
 128          The indices where we will calculate the chisq. These must be relative
 129          to the given `corr` series.
 130  
 131      Returns
 132      -------
 133      chisq: Array
 134          An array containing only the chisq at the selected points.
 135      """
 136      num_bins = len(bins) - 1
 137      chisq = shift_sum(corr, indices, bins) # pylint:disable=assignment-from-no-return
 138      return (chisq * num_bins - (snr.conj() * snr).real) * (snr_norm ** 2.0)
 139  
 140  _q_l = None
 141  _qtilde_l = None
 142  _chisq_l = None
 143  def power_chisq_from_precomputed(corr, snr, snr_norm, bins, indices=None, return_bins=False):
 144      """Calculate the chisq timeseries from precomputed values.
 145  
 146      This function calculates the chisq at all times by performing an
 147      inverse FFT of each bin.
 148  
 149      Parameters
 150      ----------
 151  
 152      corr: FrequencySeries
 153          The produce of the template and data in the frequency domain.
 154      snr: TimeSeries
 155          The unnormalized snr time series.
 156      snr_norm:
 157          The snr normalization factor (true snr = snr * snr_norm) EXPLAINME - define 'true snr'?
 158      bins: List of integers
 159          The edges of the chisq bins.
 160      indices: {Array, None}, optional
 161          Index values into snr that indicate where to calculate
 162          chisq values. If none, calculate chisq for all possible indices.
 163      return_bins: {boolean, False}, optional
 164          Return a list of the SNRs for each chisq bin.
 165  
 166      Returns
 167      -------
 168      chisq: TimeSeries
 169      """
 170      # Get workspace memory
 171      global _q_l, _qtilde_l, _chisq_l
 172  
 173      bin_snrs = []
 174  
 175      if _q_l is None or len(_q_l) != len(snr):
 176          q = zeros(len(snr), dtype=complex_same_precision_as(snr))
 177          qtilde = zeros(len(snr), dtype=complex_same_precision_as(snr))
 178          _q_l = q
 179          _qtilde_l = qtilde
 180      else:
 181          q = _q_l
 182          qtilde = _qtilde_l
 183  
 184      if indices is not None:
 185          snr = snr.take(indices)
 186  
 187      if _chisq_l is None or len(_chisq_l) < len(snr):
 188          chisq = zeros(len(snr), dtype=real_same_precision_as(snr))
 189          _chisq_l = chisq
 190      else:
 191          chisq = _chisq_l[0:len(snr)]
 192          chisq.clear()
 193  
 194      num_bins = len(bins) - 1
 195  
 196      for j in range(num_bins):
 197          k_min = int(bins[j])
 198          k_max = int(bins[j+1])
 199  
 200          qtilde[k_min:k_max] = corr[k_min:k_max]
 201          pycbc.fft.ifft(qtilde, q)
 202          qtilde[k_min:k_max].clear()
 203  
 204          if return_bins:
 205              bin_snrs.append(TimeSeries(q  * snr_norm *  num_bins ** 0.5,
 206                                        delta_t=snr.delta_t,
 207                                        epoch=snr.start_time))
 208  
 209          if indices is not None:
 210              chisq_accum_bin(chisq, q.take(indices))
 211          else:
 212              chisq_accum_bin(chisq, q)
 213  
 214      chisq = (chisq * num_bins - snr.squared_norm()) * (snr_norm ** 2.0)
 215  
 216      if indices is None:
 217          chisq = TimeSeries(chisq, delta_t=snr.delta_t, epoch=snr.start_time, copy=False)
 218  
 219      if return_bins:
 220          return chisq, bin_snrs
 221      else:
 222          return chisq

 225  def fastest_power_chisq_at_points(corr, snr, snrv, snr_norm, bins, indices):
 226      """Calculate the chisq values for only selected points.
 227  
 228      This function looks at the number of points to be evaluated and selects
 229      the fastest method (FFT, or direct time shift and sum). In either case,
 230      only the selected points are returned.
 231  
 232      Parameters
 233      ----------
 234      corr: FrequencySeries
 235          The product of the template and data in the frequency domain.
 236      snr: Array
 237          The unnormalized snr
 238      snr_norm: float
 239          The snr normalization factor  --- EXPLAINME
 240      bins: List of integers
 241          The edges of the equal power bins
 242      indices: Array
 243          The indices where we will calculate the chisq. These must be relative
 244          to the given `snr` series.
 245  
 246      Returns
 247      -------
 248      chisq: Array
 249          An array containing only the chisq at the selected points.
 250      """
 251      import pycbc.scheme
 252      if isinstance(pycbc.scheme.mgr.state, pycbc.scheme.CPUScheme):
 253          # We don't have that many points so do the direct time shift.
 254          return power_chisq_at_points_from_precomputed(corr, snrv,
 255                                                        snr_norm, bins, indices)
 256      else:
 257          # We have a lot of points so it is faster to use the fourier transform
 258          return power_chisq_from_precomputed(corr, snr, snr_norm, bins,
 259                                              indices=indices)

 262  def power_chisq(template, data, num_bins, psd,
 263                  low_frequency_cutoff=None,
 264                  high_frequency_cutoff=None,
 265                  return_bins=False):
 266      """Calculate the chisq timeseries
 267  
 268      Parameters
 269      ----------
 270      template: FrequencySeries or TimeSeries
 271          A time or frequency series that contains the filter template.
 272      data: FrequencySeries or TimeSeries
 273          A time or frequency series that contains the data to filter. The length
 274          must be commensurate with the template.
 275          (EXPLAINME - does this mean 'the same as' or something else?)
 276      num_bins: int
 277          The number of frequency bins used for chisq. The number of statistical
 278          degrees of freedom ('dof') is 2*num_bins-2.
 279      psd: FrequencySeries
 280          The psd of the data.
 281      low_frequency_cutoff: {None, float}, optional
 282          The low frequency cutoff for the filter
 283      high_frequency_cutoff: {None, float}, optional
 284          The high frequency cutoff for the filter
 285      return_bins: {boolean, False}, optional
 286          Return a list of the individual chisq bins
 287  
 288      Returns
 289      -------
 290      chisq: TimeSeries
 291          TimeSeries containing the chisq values for all times.
 292      """
 293      htilde = make_frequency_series(template)
 294      stilde = make_frequency_series(data)
 295  
 296      bins = power_chisq_bins(htilde, num_bins, psd, low_frequency_cutoff,
 297                              high_frequency_cutoff)
 298      corra = zeros((len(htilde) - 1) * 2, dtype=htilde.dtype)
 299      total_snr, corr, tnorm = matched_filter_core(htilde, stilde, psd,
 300                             low_frequency_cutoff, high_frequency_cutoff,
 301                             corr_out=corra)
 302  
 303      return power_chisq_from_precomputed(corr, total_snr, tnorm, bins, return_bins=return_bins)

 306  class SingleDetPowerChisq(object):
 307      """Class that handles precomputation and memory management for efficiently
 308      running the power chisq in a single detector inspiral analysis.
 309      """
 310      def __init__(self, num_bins=0, snr_threshold=None):
 311          if not (num_bins == "0" or num_bins == 0):
 312              self.do = True
 313              self.column_name = "chisq"
 314              self.table_dof_name = "chisq_dof"
 315              self.num_bins = num_bins
 316          else:
 317              self.do = False
 318          self.snr_threshold = snr_threshold
 319  
 320      @staticmethod
 321      def parse_option(row, arg):
 322          safe_dict = {'max': max, 'min': min}
 323          safe_dict.update(row.__dict__)
 324          safe_dict.update(math.__dict__)
 325          safe_dict.update(pycbc.pnutils.__dict__)
 326          return eval(arg, {"__builtins__":None}, safe_dict)
 327  
 328      def cached_chisq_bins(self, template, psd):
 329          from pycbc.opt import LimitedSizeDict
 330  
 331          key = id(psd)
 332          if not hasattr(psd, '_chisq_cached_key'):
 333              psd._chisq_cached_key = {}
 334  
 335          if not hasattr(template, '_bin_cache'):
 336              template._bin_cache = LimitedSizeDict(size_limit=2**2)
 337  
 338          if key not in template._bin_cache or id(template.params) not in psd._chisq_cached_key:
 339              psd._chisq_cached_key[id(template.params)] = True
 340              num_bins = int(self.parse_option(template, self.num_bins))
 341  
 342              if hasattr(psd, 'sigmasq_vec') and \
 343                      template.approximant in psd.sigmasq_vec:
 344                  kmin = int(template.f_lower / psd.delta_f)
 345                  kmax = template.end_idx
 346                  bins = power_chisq_bins_from_sigmasq_series(
 347                      psd.sigmasq_vec[template.approximant],
 348                      num_bins,
 349                      kmin,
 350                      kmax
 351                  )
 352              else:
 353                  bins = power_chisq_bins(template, num_bins, psd, template.f_lower)
 354              template._bin_cache[key] = bins
 355  
 356          return template._bin_cache[key]
 357  
 358      def values(self, corr, snrv, snr_norm, psd, indices, template):
 359          """ Calculate the chisq at points given by indices.
 360  
 361          Returns
 362          -------
 363          chisq: Array
 364              Chisq values, one for each sample index, or zero for points below
 365              the specified SNR threshold
 366  
 367          chisq_dof: Array
 368              Number of statistical degrees of freedom for the chisq test
 369              in the given template, equal to 2 * num_bins - 2
 370          """
 371          if self.do:
 372              num_above = len(indices)
 373              dof = -100
 374              if self.snr_threshold:
 375                  above = abs(snrv * snr_norm) > self.snr_threshold
 376                  num_above = above.sum()
 377                  logging.info('%s above chisq activation threshold' % num_above)
 378                  above_indices = indices[above]
 379                  above_snrv = snrv[above]
 380                  chisq_out = numpy.zeros(len(indices), dtype=numpy.float32)
 381              else:
 382                  above_indices = indices
 383                  above_snrv = snrv
 384  
 385              if num_above > 0:
 386                  bins = self.cached_chisq_bins(template, psd)
 387                  # len(bins) is number of bin edges, num_bins = len(bins) - 1
 388                  dof = (len(bins) - 1) * 2 - 2
 389                  _chisq = power_chisq_at_points_from_precomputed(corr,
 390                                       above_snrv, snr_norm, bins, above_indices)
 391  
 392              if self.snr_threshold:
 393                  if num_above > 0:
 394                      chisq_out[above] = _chisq
 395              else:
 396                  if num_above == 0:
 397                      chisq_out = numpy.zeros(0, dtype=numpy.float32)
 398                  else:
 399                      chisq_out = _chisq
 400  
 401              return chisq_out, numpy.repeat(dof, len(indices))# dof * numpy.ones_like(indices)
 402          else:
 403              return None, None

 406  class SingleDetSkyMaxPowerChisq(SingleDetPowerChisq):
 407      """Class that handles precomputation and memory management for efficiently
 408      running the power chisq in a single detector inspiral analysis when
 409      maximizing analytically over sky location.
 410      """
 411      def __init__(self, **kwds):
 412          super(SingleDetSkyMaxPowerChisq, self).__init__(**kwds)
 413          self.template_mem = None
 414          self.corr_mem = None
 415  
 416      def calculate_chisq_bins(self, template, psd):
 417          """ Obtain the chisq bins for this template and PSD.
 418          """
 419          num_bins = int(self.parse_option(template, self.num_bins))
 420          if hasattr(psd, 'sigmasq_vec') and \
 421                                         template.approximant in psd.sigmasq_vec:
 422              kmin = int(template.f_lower / psd.delta_f)
 423              kmax = template.end_idx
 424              bins = power_chisq_bins_from_sigmasq_series(
 425                     psd.sigmasq_vec[template.approximant], num_bins, kmin, kmax)
 426          else:
 427              bins = power_chisq_bins(template, num_bins, psd, template.f_lower)
 428          return bins
 429  
 430      def values(self, corr_plus, corr_cross, snrv, psd,
 431                 indices, template_plus, template_cross, u_vals,
 432                 hplus_cross_corr, hpnorm, hcnorm):
 433          """ Calculate the chisq at points given by indices.
 434  
 435          Returns
 436          -------
 437          chisq: Array
 438              Chisq values, one for each sample index
 439  
 440          chisq_dof: Array
 441              Number of statistical degrees of freedom for the chisq test
 442              in the given template
 443          """
 444          if self.do:
 445              num_above = len(indices)
 446              if self.snr_threshold:
 447                  above = abs(snrv) > self.snr_threshold
 448                  num_above = above.sum()
 449                  logging.info('%s above chisq activation threshold' % num_above)
 450                  above_indices = indices[above]
 451                  above_snrv = snrv[above]
 452                  u_vals = u_vals[above]
 453                  rchisq = numpy.zeros(len(indices), dtype=numpy.float32)
 454                  dof = -100
 455              else:
 456                  above_indices = indices
 457                  above_snrv = snrv
 458  
 459              if num_above > 0:
 460                  chisq = []
 461                  curr_tmplt_mult_fac = 0.
 462                  curr_corr_mult_fac = 0.
 463                  if self.template_mem is None or \
 464                          (not len(self.template_mem) == len(template_plus)):
 465                      self.template_mem = zeros(len(template_plus),
 466                                  dtype=complex_same_precision_as(corr_plus))
 467                  if self.corr_mem is None or \
 468                                  (not len(self.corr_mem) == len(corr_plus)):
 469                      self.corr_mem = zeros(len(corr_plus),
 470                                  dtype=complex_same_precision_as(corr_plus))
 471  
 472                  tmplt_data = template_cross.data
 473                  corr_data = corr_cross.data
 474                  numpy.copyto(self.template_mem.data, template_cross.data)
 475                  numpy.copyto(self.corr_mem.data, corr_cross.data)
 476                  template_cross._data = self.template_mem.data
 477                  corr_cross._data = self.corr_mem.data
 478  
 479                  for lidx, index in enumerate(above_indices):
 480                      above_local_indices = numpy.array([index])
 481                      above_local_snr = numpy.array([above_snrv[lidx]])
 482                      local_u_val = u_vals[lidx]
 483                      # Construct template from _plus and _cross
 484                      # Note that this modifies in place, so we store that and
 485                      # revert on the next pass.
 486                      template = template_cross.multiply_and_add(template_plus,
 487                                                 local_u_val-curr_tmplt_mult_fac)
 488                      curr_tmplt_mult_fac = local_u_val
 489  
 490                      template.f_lower = template_plus.f_lower
 491                      template.params = template_plus.params
 492                      # Construct the corr vector
 493                      norm_fac = local_u_val*local_u_val + 1
 494                      norm_fac += 2 * local_u_val * hplus_cross_corr
 495                      norm_fac = hcnorm / (norm_fac**0.5)
 496                      hp_fac = local_u_val * hpnorm / hcnorm
 497                      corr = corr_cross.multiply_and_add(corr_plus,
 498                                                     hp_fac - curr_corr_mult_fac)
 499                      curr_corr_mult_fac = hp_fac
 500  
 501                      bins = self.calculate_chisq_bins(template, psd)
 502                      dof = (len(bins) - 1) * 2 - 2
 503                      curr_chisq = power_chisq_at_points_from_precomputed(corr,
 504                                            above_local_snr/ norm_fac, norm_fac,
 505                                            bins, above_local_indices)
 506                      chisq.append(curr_chisq[0])
 507                  chisq = numpy.array(chisq)
 508                  # Must reset corr and template to original values!
 509                  template_cross._data = tmplt_data
 510                  corr_cross._data = corr_data
 511  
 512              if self.snr_threshold:
 513                  if num_above > 0:
 514                      rchisq[above] = chisq
 515              else:
 516                  rchisq = chisq
 517  
 518              return rchisq, numpy.repeat(dof, len(indices))# dof * numpy.ones_like(indices)
 519          else:
 520              return None, None
